name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=play/graphics, descriptor accurately states it plays an ANI.DAT file animation sequence). No Ghidra address residue. Matches body: reads ANI.DAT, decodes multi-frame animation onto mode-13h framebuffer 0xA0000 via the shared ANI decoder.
purpose: Play a multi-frame ANI.DAT animation onto the VGA mode-13h framebuffer (0xA0000) through the shared ANI delta-RLE decoder, with a per-frame delay and optional skip-on-keypress.
logic_summary: __CHK(0x38); clear kbd. If anim_idx==1 (intro animation) load FDOTHER.DAT[0x4E] as a chime SFX into sfx_buf. malloc 0x300 scratch (decoder delta tables) + malloc 64000 backbuf; fd2_ani_decoder_set_target_buffer(64000, 0xA0000, scratch). fopen ANI.DAT; fseek to anim_idx*4+6 (TOC entry); fread 8B index; fseek to *(u32)index (stream offset); fread 0xAD-byte stream header; frame_count = header[0xA5] (int16). Loop frame_iter in [0,frame_count): fread 8B frame header (frame_data_size=hdr[0] raw byte count, frame_decoded_size=hdr[2] decoded chunk count); fread frame_data_size raw bytes into backbuf; fd2_ani_decoder_decode_frame_bytes(frame_decoded_size, backbuf) applies the delta against current 0xA0000; if anim_idx==1 && frame_iter==0 fire chime; fd2_delay_ms(per_frame_delay); if skip_on_key_flag && keyboard buffer nonempty -> break; else clear kbd. After loop free scratch+backbuf; if sfx_buf!=0 stop chime (fd2_play_sfx_with_handle(sfx_buf,-1,1)) + free; fclose. Original tail JMPs into shared __CHK epilogue at 0x19518; emitted as a plain return.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_play_ani_file_animation_sequence(uint32 anim_idx, uint32 per_frame_delay, uint32 skip_on_key_flag)

params.name: anim_idx
params.semantics: Animation index into ANI.DAT; its TOC entry sits at file offset anim_idx*4 + 6. anim_idx==1 is the intro animation (gets the FDOTHER.DAT[0x4E] chime SFX). Call sites pass 0/1/2/3 plus a pass-through from fd2_load_and_fade_in_cinematic_image.
params.reason: Descriptive, no address residue; matches both body usage (fseek anim_idx*4+6, anim_idx==1 intro branch) and all 4 callers.

params.name: per_frame_delay
params.semantics: Per-frame wait passed straight to fd2_delay_ms each frame (BIOS ticks, ~55ms each). Callers pass 0xF / 0x5A / 100.
params.reason: Accurately names the value; no address residue; matches fd2_delay_ms(per_frame_delay) in the loop.

params.name: skip_on_key_flag
params.semantics: If non-zero the loop polls the keyboard buffer (fd2_check_keyboard_buffer_nonempty) after each frame and breaks early on any keystroke. Callers pass 0 (slideshow/cinematic image) or 1 (ending mid-ANI / clear-panel zoom).
params.reason: Clear boolean-flag name reflecting the early-break behavior; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. (Original control flow JMPs into the shared __CHK epilogue at 0x19518 for stack teardown/RET; semantically a plain return.)

reads_globals: data_fd2_string_resource_filename_fdother_dat ("FDOTHER.DAT" filename string, used only when anim_idx==1)
